result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers on the input files. I checked the outputs by eye against the data. I did not check the Q11 blank-line and indented-comment cases beyond the output looking right.

Q11 trims each whole line, so a value with trailing spaces would lose them. `app.env` has none that I could see.

**Notes on the documentation**
- **What the first page covered well:** the combinators, the literal shapes, the failure tags and the "write the shape of the answer as a literal" idea were all clear. Several laws were close to usable as written.
- **What it left out:**
  - Turning a numeric string into a number. The page says nothing is converted, but doesn't say how to convert. I guessed `parseJson` on a string, and it worked.
  - Building a map from key/value pairs. I used `tag ::map` on a vector of pairs, copied from the `entries | tag ::map` law.
  - `descending` sorting inside `sort`. `(/n | desc)` appears on the page, but I only saw it work once I tried it.
  - Splitting at the first `=` only. I used `split`, then `drop 1 | join "="`.
- **Where I stumbled:**
  - In Q2, `/price | mul /qty` failed because `/price` replaces the pipe value, so `/qty` has nothing to read. I fixed it with `:i /` to name the record, then `i | /qty`.
  - In Q8, `/p` after `append ":"` failed for the same reason. I fixed it by building the string with `[/n (/p | print)] | join ":"`.
  - `!| explain | content` failed, because `explain` returns an `::explanation` value, not a doc. I didn't pursue it.
- **Output format:** answers print as qlang literals, so the Q6 and Q11 maps show keywords as `:Eng`.

Q1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | * /email | sort
Q2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") * /items | flat | * (:i / | /price | mul (i | /qty)) | sum | round 2
Q3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
Q4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * (entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * /0) | flat | sort
Q5: lines | * split " " | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
Q6: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") * {:d /1 :s (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~(/d) | * (* /s | avg | round 1)
Q7: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Date ","cherry"] | * lower | distinct | count
Q8: at :services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) * {:n /name :p (at :net | coalesce {} | at :port | coalesce 80)} | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) * ([/n (/p | print)] | join ":")
Q9: groupBy ~(/user) * count | entries * {:user /0 :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /user]) | take 3
Q10: sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /title
Q11: lines | * trim | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * (split "=" | [(/0 | drop 3 | lower) (drop 1 | join "=")]) | tag ::map
Q12: filter ~(/total | gt 100) | every ~(at :shipped_at | ne null)
Q13: * (at :tags | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
Q14: groupBy ~(/endpoint) | vals | filter ~(count | gte 2) * {:endpoint (/0/endpoint) :count count :avgMs (* (at :latency_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 0)} | sort ~(/endpoint)
